functions.description: Unicode uppercase copy; may expand; no locale tailoring or normalization; bounded to 1 MiB.

functions.name: str_lower
functions.description: Unicode lowercase copy, including contextual final sigma; no locale tailoring or normalization; bounded to 1 MiB.

functions.name: str_bytes_len
functions.description: Count UTF-8 bytes, distinct from len(text) Unicode scalar count. No terminator or capacity.

functions.name: sizeof
functions.description: Text-only UTF-8 payload byte count, alias of str_bytes_len. Not C object size or RAM usage; other types refuse.

functions.name: str_compare
functions.description: Return -1, 0, +1 using case-sensitive, locale-independent UTF-8 lexicographic order; no normalization.

functions.name: to_base
functions.description: Format a unitless integer within ±(2^53-1), base 2/8/10/16; sign-magnitude text, no prefixes or two's complement.

functions.name: from_base
functions.description: Parse signed integer text, base 2/8/10/16, exact range ±(2^53-1); trims edges; refuses prefixes, fractions and separators.

functions.name: fluid_density
functions.description: mass/volume, kg/m^3. Nonnegative mass; positive volume; checked SI dimensions.

functions.name: fluid_kinematic_viscosity
functions.description: mu/rho, m^2/s. Both arguments positive with SI dimensions.

functions.name: fluid_dynamic_viscosity
functions.description: nu*rho, Pa*s. Both arguments positive with SI dimensions.

functions.name: fluid_volume_flow
functions.description: Signed volume flow = positive area * signed mean normal velocity, m^3/s.

functions.name: fluid_flow_speed
functions.description: Signed mean normal velocity = volume flow / positive area, m/s.

functions.name: fluid_reynolds
functions.description: rho*abs(v)*L/mu; dimensionless. Positive density, length, viscosity. General diagnostic, not proof of a flow regime.

functions.name: fluid_dynamic_pressure
functions.description: rho*v^2/2, Pa. Positive density; signed scalar velocity; not automatically total pressure.

functions.name: fluid_bernoulli_total_pressure
functions.description: p+rho*v^2/2, Pa. Same-height, steady, incompressible, inviscid streamline model; no pumps, losses or heating; assumptions are user responsibility.

functions.name: fluid_pipe_pressure_drop
functions.description: Signed Poiseuille drop 8*mu*L*Q/(pi*r^4), Pa. Circular fully developed Newtonian incompressible laminar flow; enforces Re < 2000 but cannot prove other assumptions. Radius, not diameter.

functions.name: str_to_hex
functions.description: Encode UTF-8 bytes as fixed-width 2-digit base-16 groups; no separators; at most 1 MiB. Not encryption.

functions.name: str_from_hex
functions.description: Decode fixed-width 2-digit base-16 byte groups; rejects invalid digits, bytes above 255 and invalid UTF-8; no prefixes or separators.

functions.name: str_to_octal
functions.description: Encode UTF-8 bytes as fixed-width 3-digit base-8 groups; no separators; at most 1 MiB. Not encryption.

functions.name: str_from_octal
functions.description: Decode fixed-width 3-digit base-8 byte groups; rejects invalid digits, bytes above 255 and invalid UTF-8; no prefixes or separators.

functions.name: str_to_binary
functions.description: Encode UTF-8 bytes as fixed-width 8-digit base-2 groups; no separators; at most 1 MiB. Not encryption.

functions.name: str_from_binary
functions.description: Decode fixed-width 8-digit base-2 byte groups; rejects invalid digits, bytes above 255 and invalid UTF-8; no prefixes or separators.

functions.name: net_pair_credentials
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Generate a dedicated 90-day TLS pair for an explicit RFC1918 LAN IPv4 address (loopback allowed for tests). New owner-only directory; separate server/client folders contain only their own private keys. The trusted setup computer sees both identities; no CA signing key is saved. Transfer only the intended role folder through a trusted channel and verify the CA fingerprint independently. Learning setup, not managed production PKI.

functions.name: net_demo_credentials
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Create a new owner-only directory containing fresh CA/server/client PEM credentials, valid 90 days for localhost learning. Refuses existing paths. CA signing key is not saved; never share private demo keys.

functions.name: net_allow
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Permit this exact numeric IP:port for the current execution. Loopback is allowed by default; wildcard, broadcast and multicast addresses are refused. Not an OS firewall or sandbox.

functions.name: net_timeout
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Set total per-operation deadline in integer milliseconds, 1–60000; default 30000. Partial traffic does not reset the deadline.

functions.name: net_listen
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Bind a TLS 1.3 listener requiring a trusted client certificate. Numeric IP:port; loopback by default. Returns a handle. No plaintext or certificate bypass.

functions.name: net_connect
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. TLS 1.3 with verified server certificate/name and mandatory client identity. Explicit PEM CA; numeric endpoint; no DNS/proxy/redirect/fallback. Returns a connection handle.

functions.name: net_accept
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Accept one mutually authenticated TLS 1.3 connection within the total timeout. Each listener is synchronous; no automatic concurrent server or application authorization.

functions.name: net_send
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Send one UTF-8 message, at most 1 MiB, with a four-byte big-endian length prefix inside TLS. Transport failure retires the connection. Delivery/application processing is not guaranteed by send success.

functions.name: net_receive
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Receive one bounded UTF-8 message. Oversized, truncated, invalid-UTF8 or failed frames refuse and retire the connection. Treat received text as untrusted; do not print terminal controls directly.

functions.name: net_close
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Close a listener or connection; repeated/unknown closes refuse. Handles are owned by one execution and sockets close on drop. Not a secure-erasure guarantee.

functions.name: net_address
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Return the local numeric socket address for an open listener/connection. Listener port zero selects an ephemeral port.

functions.name: net_peer_sha256
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Return SHA-256 of the authenticated peer leaf certificate DER. Compare with an independently obtained value for application authorization; this is not a message signature.

functions.name: e2e_keygen
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Generate an age X25519 identity using OS cryptographic randomness. Write a new owner-only private key and optional new public-key file; return public recipient key. Refuses overwrite; operations are not transactional.

functions.name: e2e_public_key
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Read an owner-only age identity and return its public recipient key. Refuses symlinks; authenticate the public key independently before distribution.

functions.name: e2e_encrypt
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Encrypt up to 512 KiB UTF-8 to one age X25519 public recipient; return canonical padded Base64 of standard binary age v1. Relay needs no private key. No sender authentication, replay prevention, forward secrecy or post-quantum claim.

functions.name: e2e_decrypt
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only. Authenticate and decrypt an at-most-1-MiB Base64 age message using an owner-only X25519 private-key file. Rejects wrong keys, corruption, truncation, oversized results and scrypt messages. Returns UTF-8 only after full authentication.

functions.name: input_secret
functions.description: Read a masked password in GO_PRIVATE only. No scientific input event or replay file. Returns ordinary in-memory text; never print real passwords.

functions.name: encrypt_text
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only: authenticated age encryption of UTF-8 text into a new file; minimum 12-byte passphrase. Returns true; errors stop execution.

functions.name: encrypt_file
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only: age-encrypt an existing regular file to a new destination. No overwrite or scientific receipt.

functions.name: decrypt_file
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only: authenticate fully before publishing a new plaintext file; exact binary bytes. Returns true or refuses.

functions.name: decrypt_text
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only: authenticate and decode at most 1 MiB UTF-8 plaintext in memory. Does not create a plaintext file.

functions.name: read_text
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only: read at most 1 MiB UTF-8 from a regular file. Returns raw text; print() is an explicit plaintext disclosure.

functions.name: display_file
functions.description: GO_PRIVATE only: display a bounded UTF-8 file with terminal controls escaped. Explicit plaintext disclosure; returns true.

functions.name: str_b64
functions.description: Encode UTF-8 as RFC 4648 standard padded Base64, at most 1 MiB output. Encoding only, NOT encryption; ordinary run evidence remains plaintext.

functions.name: str_to_b64
functions.description: Alias for str_b64: standard padded Base64; not encryption.

functions.name: str_from_b64
functions.description: Decode canonical standard padded Base64 to UTF-8. Refuses whitespace, URL alphabet, invalid padding bits and non-UTF-8 output.

statements.name: COMPLETELY_MAD
statements.description: First top-level directive. Implies GO_PARANOID; automatically seals final user-global values separately from explicit snapshots. At most 256 bindings and 8 MiB; no inline Rust or unaudited standalone native execution. Failed captures refuse PASS. Evidence integrity, not encryption or scientific validity.

statements.name: GO_NUMERIC_AUDIT
statements.description: Main-source directive naming an explicit JSON configuration; requires run --compile. Compare named scalar seals with exact bits and dimensions on this machine; not an accuracy certificate or cross-platform guarantee. No comparison during check preview.

statements.name: GO_LOOP_BUDGET
statements.description: One main-source declaration, 1 to 50,000,000 shared loop-body entries; default 1,000,000. Requested/effective/used budget is audited; not a sandbox.

statements.name: import
statements.description: Statically import local .gbl g_func libraries; no top-level execution or hidden inline Rust. Paths stay below the entry source directory.

statements.name: GO_PARANOID
statements.description: Optional stricter evidence mode: postflight source observation and receipt self-check; not a sandbox.

statements.name: seal
statements.description: Optionally snapshot a variable or registered constant as a separate typed run artifact.

statements.name: g_func
statements.description: Declare a top-level user function with local copy-value arguments; every reached path must return.

statements.name: return
statements.description: Return a value from g_func, including inside a branch or loop.

statements.name: for
statements.description: Iterate a half-open integer range or independent array value; shared default 1,000,000 loop-body entries, configurable to 50,000,000 with GO_LOOP_BUDGET.

statements.name: in
statements.description: Connects a for-loop variable to range(...) or an array expression.

statements.name: range
statements.description: Half-open integer bounds used only in for ... in range(...).

statements.name: while
statements.description: Repeat while a Boolean condition is true; subject to the shared loop limit.

statements.name: break
statements.description: Exit the nearest containing for or while loop.

statements.name: continue
statements.description: Start the next iteration of the nearest containing for or while loop.

statements.name: and
statements.description: Short-circuit Boolean conjunction.

statements.name: or
statements.description: Short-circuit Boolean disjunction.

statements.name: not
statements.description: Boolean negation.

statements.name: if
statements.description: Execute a branch when its condition is Boolean true.

statements.name: else
statements.description: Optional if fallback; `else if` tests another Boolean condition.

statements.name: switch
statements.description: Evaluate a selector once, then execute the first exact, dimension-aware matching case without fallthrough.

statements.name: case
statements.description: A lazily evaluated switch label. The first exact match wins.

statements.name: default
statements.description: Optional final switch branch if no case matches.

statements.name: argc
statements.description: Read-only count of program arguments, including argv(0).

statements.name: true
statements.description: Boolean true literal.

statements.name: false
statements.description: Boolean false literal.

statements.name: RUST_INLINE_BEGIN
statements.description: Starts arbitrary native Rust; compiled mode and exact SHA-256 authorization required.

statements.name: RUST_INLINE_END
statements.description: Ends an inline Rust block.

statements.name: GO_PRIVATE
statements.description: First main-source directive. Confidential file scripts: no scientific source snapshots, receipts, logs, seals or final-state capture. Incompatible with GO_PARANOID, COMPLETELY_MAD, numeric audits, inline Rust and scientific I/O. Not an OS sandbox or secure-erasure guarantee.
